maddeler.e:
أتعالق (form VI)
# أَتَعَالَقُ (ʔataʕālaqu) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.la.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَعَالَقَ (taʕālaqa)
# أَتَعَالَقَ (ʔataʕālaqa) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.la.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَالَقَ (taʕālaqa)
# أَتَعَالَقْ (ʔataʕālaq) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.laq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَعَالَقَ (taʕālaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
